text:
ترے کم نکم—
گاں چونا، منجی اننا، تریا رسی بھن۔
romanized:
Tré kamm nakamm—
Gā̃ chōṇā, manjjī uṇṇā, trīā rassī bhann.
literal_en:
Three pieces of work are no work at all—
Milking a cow, weaving a bed, thirdly, twisting a rope.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
